items.description: Perched high above the pristine waters of Lake Pend Oreille, this extraordinary estate offers a rare combination of privacy, scale, and exceptional development potential. Encompassing substantial acreage along a secluded ridgeline, the property captures sweeping, unobstructed views of the lake and surrounding mountain ranges while providing a level of seclusion that is increasingly difficult to find. At the heart of the estate is a beautifully designed modern mountain compound featuring a primary residence with four bedrooms and four-and-a-half bathrooms, complemented by a separate guest home offering three bedrooms, three bathrooms, loft space, and 3,081 square feet of additional living area. Together, the residences create an ideal setting for multigenerational living, executive retreats, or hosting family and guests in complete comfort and privacy. The true value lies in the land itself. With expansive open areas, multiple potential building sites, and significant distance from neighboring properties, the estate offers remarkable flexibility for future development—whether as a legacy family compound, additional guest residences, or a private retreat designed to evolve over time. Walls of glass, exposed timber beams, and thoughtfully curated indoor and outdoor spaces frame the surrounding landscape at every turn. Terraces, stonework, and landscaped grounds provide front-row views of sunrise over the lake and sunsets behind the mountains, while bald eagles, deer, and a resident herd of elk reinforce the property’s extraordinary connection to the natural environment. Located near Hope and just a short drive to Sandpoint and Schweitzer Mountain Resort, this one-of-a-kind North Idaho estate offers unmatched privacy, architectural sophistication, and long-term upside in one of the Inland Northwest’s most sought-after destinations.

Welcome to historic Cottage Island, a picturesque retreat nestled amidst the natural beauty of Hope. This exclusive and private island oasis offers an unparalleled opportunity to embrace a serene and luxurious lifestyle surrounded by pristine landscapes and breathtaking waterfront views. Escape to the tranquil paradise of Cottage Island located just off the coast of Hope. This enchanting island boasts nearly 9 acres with multiple build sites and features mature trees, beautiful rock outcroppings, multiple pebble beaches and unique topography. Cottage Island presents an array of outdoor amenities to enhance your island lifestyle. Stroll along the shoreline, dip your toes in the crystal-clear waters, or set sail from your private boat dock to explore the surrounding coastline. A cozy fire pit is perfect for evenings spent under the starlit sky, fostering unforgettable moments and cherished memories. Though Cottage Island feels secluded, it is conveniently located just a short boat ride away from the charming town of Hope and Holiday Shores marina. Immerse yourself in the rich natural wonders of the area, including hiking trails, wildlife spotting, and fishing adventures. You must see for yourself to truly experience the beauty and tranquility that is Cottage Island.

Exceptional waterfront living in Dover Bay. Set on just over an acre with private water frontage, a private dock and boat lifts, this beautifully appointed 4,798-square-foot residence/ADU was designed to make the most of life on the water. The primary residence features 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms and 2 half bathrooms with the ADU featuring 2 bedroom (1 currently an office), 1 full bath, 1 half bath and the potential to add an additional 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. From the moment you enter, the soaring ceilings, warm wood accents, dramatic architectural details and wall of windows create an impressive connection between the home and its waterfront setting. Designed with entertaining in mind, the open living spaces flow effortlessly to an expansive covered outdoor living area overlooking the water. A sophisticated owner’s lounge/game room with a custom wet bar offers the perfect setting for cocktails, cards and evenings with friends, while a dedicated theater/golf simulator space adds another level of year-round recreation. Multiple gathering areas provide plenty of room to entertain on a grand scale while still feeling comfortable and inviting for everyday living. The ADU offers additional flex space, ideal for guests, extended stays, a private office or additional recreation space. With an impressive five total garage bays, there is plenty of room for vehicles, lake toys and all the gear that comes with the North Idaho lifestyle. Outside, the experience is all about the water, views and privacy. Relax beneath the covered patio, gather around the lakefront fire pit, or follow the path directly to your private dock and boat lifts for effortless days on the lake. With more than an acre of beautifully situated grounds, this property offers a rare combination of privacy, space and direct waterfront access within the coveted Dover Bay community. More than a waterfront home, this is a true North Idaho retreat, built for boating, entertaining, hosting and enjoying life's moments on the lake.

Welcome to Seasons at Sandpoint’s newest addition: Building 8. Discover the ultimate in luxury living with these impressive waterfront condominiums, ready for occupancy this season. This spacious 4,642 sq ft residence offers 6 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms, delivering a modern ambiance with distinctive, high-end finishes throughout. Upscale features include waterfall quartz countertops, 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, custom tile showers, and a premium Thermador appliance package. The Seasons at Sandpoint community provides an unparalleled living experience with resort-style amenities designed for relaxation and indulgence, including a year-round outdoor pool and hot tub, fitness center, multiple BBQ areas, and a private beach. In addition to the community amenities, Building 8 offers exclusive features such as a rooftop heated pool and hot tub, a brand-new fitness center, rooftop lounge, fully equipped commercial kitchen, and rooftop BBQs. Residents also enjoy the convenience of a heated underground parking garage with personal storage options. As a limited-time incentive, a boat slip is included with the first two sales in 2026. When adventure calls, endless activities await—stroll through downtown Sandpoint, explore Lake Pend Oreille by boat, ski at Schweitzer Mountain Resort, or tee off at The Idaho Club. Don’t miss this extraordinary opportunity to own a true legacy property. Model unit tours are available for your convenience.

Rare opportunities like this don't come along often. Located on the highly sought-after fourth floor of Building 8 at Seasons at Sandpoint, this exceptional 2,944-square-foot, 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom waterfront residence offers an elevated level of luxury in one of North Idaho's premier resort communities. Thoughtfully designed for both entertaining and everyday living, the open-concept floor plan features soaring 10-foot ceilings, expansive windows, premium finishes, and a gourmet kitchen complete with waterfall quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, and a Thermador appliance package. The spacious primary suite offers a spa-inspired ensuite and walk-in closet, while three additional bedrooms and bathrooms provide plenty of space for family and guests. Enjoy the privacy and exclusivity that only a fourth-floor residence can offer, along with access to Seasons' unmatched resort-style amenities, including a private beach, marina, year-round outdoor pool and spa, fitness center, and Building 8's exclusive rooftop pool, hot tub, lounge, fitness center, sauna, and entertaining spaces overlooking beautiful Lake Pend Oreille. Just minutes from downtown Sandpoint and Schweitzer Mountain Resort, this is a rare opportunity to own one of Building 8's most desirable floor plans in an unmatched waterfront setting.

Nestled beneath the majestic Cathedral Rock, amidst the lush forests and overlooking the serene Pend Oreille River and stunning mountain vistas, lies this extraordinary 34.87-acre property (5 separate lots), epitomizing the breathtaking beauty of North Idaho. The main residence, spanning an opulent 3598 sqft, boasts 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, and an array of lavish amenities, including hydronic heating and a striking Montana Stone fireplace. As you step into the home, you're welcomed by a sprawling open floor plan that seamlessly integrates the kitchen, living room, and dining areas, enveloped by expansive windows that invite abundant natural light to illuminate every corner. The modern kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, featuring top-of-the-line appliances such as a subzero refrigerator and a 5-burner Wolf range, complemented by European soft touch cabinetry, a custom backsplash, and a luxurious waterfall island. The dining room, adorned with a charming Barnwood accent wall, opens to the kitchen and offers access to the covered back patio, perfect for al fresco dining. With soaring ceilings and a cozy wood-burning fireplace, the living room exudes a tranquil ambiance, ideal for unwinding after a long day. Upstairs, panoramic views of Pen Oreille River and the surrounding mountains captivate through picturesque windows. The second floor also boasts stunning vaulted Tongue and Groove ceilings, a sprawling personal library, and a spacious formal family room overlooking the living room below. The master bedroom is a sanctuary of serenity, featuring a delightful window lounge area framing the picturesque landscape, slider access to a private balcony, and a generous walk-in closet. The ensuite bath offers a haven of relaxation with dual vanities, a large garden tub, and a custom, white-tiled shower. A second Ensuite provides a tranquil escape with ample natural light, a spacious walk-in closet, and an ensuite bath adorned with custom tile work and direct access to the covered deck. An additional bedroom downstairs offers ample space and natural light.Outside, the home's exterior seamlessly blends beautiful vintage barn wood from a local homestead with Corten Steel, harmonizing with the surrounding nature. The expansive estate is further enhanced by a whimsical treehouse, 24’X40’ pole barn with loft storage and electrical line, teepee with an expansive deck area, and a steel workshop complete with living quarters, full bath, kitchenette, recording studio, hydronic heating, independent power, and water drawn from an artesian well. This private oasis provides easy access to fine dining, shopping, boat launches, and the unparalleled beauty of Lake Pend Oreille & Pend Oreille River, with a tranquil drive into downtown Sandpoint. Discover an array of amenities, from boating on Lake Pend Oreille to skiing at Schweitzer Mountain Resort or golfing at the renowned Idaho Club, a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to own a luxurious retreat in the heart of North Idaho's stunning wilderness!

Build your mountain dream home on this premier ski-in/ski-out homesite at Mountainside on Schweitzer Mountain. Located on Basin Express Ct., this ready-to-build spacious lot is approved for two homes and offers the best direct access to the slopes. Immerse yourself with some of the most spectacular views in the region, including sweeping vistas of Lake Pend Oreille, the surrounding mountain ranges and the action packed ski runs. Enjoy year-round recreation right from your doorstep, with skiing, snowshoeing, cross country skiing, mountain biking, hiking, dining, and village amenities just moments away. Whether you're envisioning a luxury mountain retreat, a legacy property for generations to enjoy, or 2 units for investment, this exceptional homesite offers the perfect setting. Take advantage of this rare opportunity to own a ready-to-build lot with true ski-in/ski-out access, breathtaking views, and the most coveted location at Schweitzer Mountain. All utilities are available including high speed fiber optic internet.

Spanning 2,950 sq. ft., this luxurious 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom residence offers an expansive, thoughtfully designed layout perfect for families or entertaining. This unit has custom designer upgrades throughout that really set it apart from the additional units within the building. Enjoy breathtaking, panoramic views of Lake Pend Oreille from floor-to-ceiling windows and private outdoor spaces. Spacious bedrooms, modern finishes, and energy-efficient features. The open floor plan ensures seamless flow between living spaces, while upscale touches like walk-in closets, custom tile showers, and premium appliances elevate the experience. Ideal for those seeking a blend of luxury, comfort, and stunning natural beauty. Seasons at Sandpoint delivers an unparalleled lifestyle, offering amenities like an on-site spa, the Owner’s Retreat, and a private beach with a year-round outdoor heated pool and hot tub for ultimate relaxation. For adventure seekers, the location provides endless opportunities, from strolling through downtown Sandpoint and boating on Lake Pend Oreille to skiing at Schweitzer Mountain Resort and golfing at the Idaho Club, a Jack Nicklaus signature course. Building 8 exclusive amenities include Roof top pool, hot tub, gym, owners lounge, private storage, heated and secure garage parking, and access to outdoor living spaces. Schedule your showing today!

Welcome to the exquisite TOP floor 2-story penthouse at Building 8, an impressive 2,240 sqft residence offering 3 bedrooms and 3 baths, where modern elegance meets unparalleled luxury. This exceptional penthouse is designed to impress with upscale features such as striking Waterfall Quartz countertops, a private glass elevator, and a master bedroom that boasts a heated, private balcony for year-round enjoyment. The spacious interior is highlighted by 10 and 20 foot ceilings, expansive floor-to-ceiling Pella windows that flood the space with natural light, custom tile showers, and a top-tier Thermador appliance package that elevates the kitchen to new heights of sophistication. The Seasons at Sandpoint community enhances your living experience with its exceptional amenities, including a year-round outdoor pool, hot tub, fully equipped gym, numerous BBQ areas, and private beach access. Building 8 further enriches this lifestyle with its own exclusive rooftop amenities, featuring a heated pool, hot tub, fitness center, rooftop lounge, and a fully equipped commercial kitchen, perfect for hosting gatherings or enjoying a meal with breathtaking views. Additional BBQ areas on the rooftop offer yet another venue to savor the outdoors. For added convenience, the property includes a heated underground parking garage with personal storage options. When adventure calls, you’re ideally situated to explore the best of Sandpoint. Enjoy leisurely strolls through the vibrant downtown, embark on boating adventures on Lake Pend Oreille, hit the slopes at Schweitzer Mountain Resort, or tee off at the renowned Idaho Club, a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course. Don’t miss this extraordinary opportunity to own a penthouse that perfectly combines luxury, comfort, and an enviable lifestyle in one of Sandpoint’s most sought-after locations.

An extraordinary North Idaho estate where luxury, privacy, and endless possibilities converge. Set on 40 breathtaking acres just minutes from Hayden Lake, this exceptional property offers a rare opportunity to own a private retreat with stunning mountain views, premium improvements, and the space to create the lifestyle you've always envisioned. The beautifully maintained 4,229-square-foot residence features 5 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, blending timeless design with everyday comfort. Expansive windows, rich hardwood floors, and inviting living spaces create a warm atmosphere. The living room features stunning farm views and is anchored by a cozy electric fireplace, while the primary suite serves as a true private retreat, complete with its own wood-burning fireplace. The beautifully renovated ensuite features a soaking tub overlooking the picturesque pond, dual vanity, and thoughtful finishes, creating a spa-like escape. The updated kitchen showcases quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and generous workspace ideal for entertaining. A detached two-car garage is extra deep and provides additional space for parking, storage, or a hobby workspace. Outside, a picturesque approximately 2-acre pond serves as the centerpiece of the estate, surrounded by rolling pasture, mature trees, trails, and expansive open space. Whether you're an equestrian enthusiast, hobby farmer, outdoor adventurer, or simply seeking unmatched privacy, this property delivers. The impressive 36' x 72' barn features 10 horse stalls, a tack room, and a spacious loft ideal for an art studio, office, or additional storage. A 30' x 40' shop with RV hookups offers exceptional space for recreational vehicles, boats, equipment, or workshop needs, while a solar greenhouse extends your growing season. Enjoy friendly competition on your own fenced pickleball court, then unwind while taking in the peaceful North Idaho surroundings. The versatile acreage offers endless opportunities for horses, livestock, recreation, or future expansion. Rarely does a property combine luxury living with this level of functionality and usable land. Enjoy the peace and seclusion of your own private estate while remaining just minutes from Hayden Lake, downtown Hayden, Coeur d'Alene, golf, shopping, dining, and endless outdoor recreation. This is more than a home—it's a legacy property offering the very best of the North Idaho lifestyle.

Nestled on 5 picturesque acres just minutes from Sandpoint, this exceptional 3,776-square-foot custom home offers the perfect blend of timeless craftsmanship, modern technology, and extraordinary lake views. The 4-bedroom, 3-bath main residence showcases soaring ceilings, expansive windows that fill the home with natural light, beautiful wood floors, and exposed wood beams that create a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout. A thoughtfully designed kitchen features new appliances, a spacious island, and an ideal layout for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. Designed for today's lifestyle, the home is equipped with a Control4 smart home automation system, allowing seamless control of lighting, audio, climate, blinds, security, and more at the touch of a button. Step outside to enjoy the peaceful setting, complete with a charming man-made pond, mature landscaping, and ample space to relax, entertain, or explore your own private slice of North Idaho. Complementing the main residence is an attached 3-car garage, as well as an impressive detached 2+ car shop with an approximately 900-square-foot, 1-bedroom, 1-bath accessory dwelling unit. Thoughtfully designed with oversized access, the shop features a large RV-height door, making it ideal for storing a boat, Sprinter van, RV, or other recreational vehicles. Whether you're an outdoor enthusiast, collector, or simply need exceptional storage and workspace, this versatile building is designed to accommodate your lifestyle. The accessory dwelling provides the perfect space for hosting guests, accommodating multi-generational living, or creating a private home office, adding even more flexibility to this remarkable property. Combining privacy, quality craftsmanship, smart-home convenience, exceptional storage for all your North Idaho adventures, and endless versatility, this remarkable property presents a rare opportunity to enjoy refined country living just moments from the amenities, recreation, and charm of downtown Sandpoint.

Stunning natural beauty meets extravagant living in this exceptional 2,949-square-foot luxury waterfront condominium featuring 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Located in Building 8, the newest addition to Seasons at Sandpoint, this residence showcases distinctive contemporary finishes and exclusive access to the building's rooftop heated pool, 2 heated underground parking spaces, and a secure roll up storage unit. Designed with sophistication and comfort in mind, the home features quartz countertops, soaring 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, custom tile showers, and a premium Thermador appliance package. Heated underground parking and personal storage provide added convenience and security. Seasons at Sandpoint offers an unparalleled resort-style lifestyle with amenities including an in-house spa, Owner's Retreat, private beach, year-round heated outdoor pool, and hot tub. Beyond the property, endless recreation awaits—from strolling the shops and restaurants of downtown Sandpoint to boating on Lake Pend Oreille, skiing at Schweitzer Mountain Resort, and golfing at The Idaho Club, Idaho's only Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course. This is a rare opportunity to own a legacy waterfront residence in one of North Idaho's most sought-after luxury communities.

For adventure seekers, the location provides endless opportunities, from strolling through downtown Sandpoint and boating on Lake Pend Oreille to skiing at Schweitzer Mountain Resort and golfing at the Idaho Club, a Jack Nicklaus signature course. Building 8 exclusive amenities include Roof top pool, hot tub, gym, owners lounge, private storage, heated and secure garage parking, and access to outdoor living spaces. Schedule your showing today!

Welcome to the exquisite TOP floor 2-story penthouse at Building 8, an impressive 2,240 sqft residence offering 3 bedrooms and 3 baths, where modern elegance meets unparalleled luxury. This exceptional penthouse is designed to impress with upscale features such as striking Waterfall Quartz countertops, a private glass elevator, and a master bedroom that boasts a heated, private balcony for year-round enjoyment. The spacious interior is highlighted by 10 and 20 foot ceilings, expansive floor-to-ceiling Pella windows that flood the space with natural light, custom tile showers, and a top-tier Thermador appliance package that elevates the kitchen to new heights of sophistication. The Seasons at Sandpoint community enhances your living experience with its exceptional amenities, including a year-round outdoor pool, hot tub, fully equipped gym, numerous BBQ areas, and private beach access. Building 8 further enriches this lifestyle with its own exclusive rooftop amenities, featuring a heated pool, hot tub, fitness center, rooftop lounge, and a fully equipped commercial kitchen, perfect for hosting gatherings or enjoying a meal with breathtaking views. Additional BBQ areas on the rooftop offer yet another venue to savor the outdoors. For added convenience, the property includes a heated underground parking garage with personal storage options. When adventure calls, you’re ideally situated to explore the best of Sandpoint. Enjoy leisurely strolls through the vibrant downtown, embark on boating adventures on Lake Pend Oreille, hit the slopes at Schweitzer Mountain Resort, or tee off at the renowned Idaho Club, a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course. Don’t miss this extraordinary opportunity to own a penthouse that perfectly combines luxury, comfort, and an enviable lifestyle in one of Sandpoint’s most sought-after locations.

An extraordinary North Idaho estate where luxury, privacy, and endless possibilities converge. Set on 40 breathtaking acres just minutes from Hayden Lake, this exceptional property offers a rare opportunity to own a private retreat with stunning mountain views, premium improvements, and the space to create the lifestyle you've always envisioned. The beautifully maintained 4,229-square-foot residence features 5 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, blending timeless design with everyday comfort. Expansive windows, rich hardwood floors, and inviting living spaces create a warm atmosphere. The living room features stunning farm views and is anchored by a cozy electric fireplace, while the primary suite serves as a true private retreat, complete with its own wood-burning fireplace. The beautifully renovated ensuite features a soaking tub overlooking the picturesque pond, dual vanity, and thoughtful finishes, creating a spa-like escape. The updated kitchen showcases quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and generous workspace ideal for entertaining. A detached two-car garage is extra deep and provides additional space for parking, storage, or a hobby workspace. Outside, a picturesque approximately 2-acre pond serves as the centerpiece of the estate, surrounded by rolling pasture, mature trees, trails, and expansive open space. Whether you're an equestrian enthusiast, hobby farmer, outdoor adventurer, or simply seeking unmatched privacy, this property delivers. The impressive 36' x 72' barn features 10 horse stalls, a tack room, and a spacious loft ideal for an art studio, office, or additional storage. A 30' x 40' shop with RV hookups offers exceptional space for recreational vehicles, boats, equipment, or workshop needs, while a solar greenhouse extends your growing season. Enjoy friendly competition on your own fenced pickleball court, then unwind while taking in the peaceful North Idaho surroundings. The versatile acreage offers endless opportunities for horses, livestock, recreation, or future expansion. Rarely does a property combine luxury living with this level of functionality and usable land. Enjoy the peace and seclusion of your own private estate while remaining just minutes from Hayden Lake, downtown Hayden, Coeur d'Alene, golf, shopping, dining, and endless outdoor recreation. This is more than a home—it's a legacy property offering the very best of the North Idaho lifestyle.

Nestled on 5 picturesque acres just minutes from Sandpoint, this exceptional 3,776-square-foot custom home offers the perfect blend of timeless craftsmanship, modern technology, and extraordinary lake views. The 4-bedroom, 3-bath main residence showcases soaring ceilings, expansive windows that fill the home with natural light, beautiful wood floors, and exposed wood beams that create a warm, inviting atmosphere throughout. A thoughtfully designed kitchen features new appliances, a spacious island, and an ideal layout for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. Designed for today's lifestyle, the home is equipped with a Control4 smart home automation system, allowing seamless control of lighting, audio, climate, blinds, security, and more at the touch of a button. Step outside to enjoy the peaceful setting, complete with a charming man-made pond, mature landscaping, and ample space to relax, entertain, or explore your own private slice of North Idaho. Complementing the main residence is an attached 3-car garage, as well as an impressive detached 2+ car shop with an approximately 900-square-foot, 1-bedroom, 1-bath accessory dwelling unit. Thoughtfully designed with oversized access, the shop features a large RV-height door, making it ideal for storing a boat, Sprinter van, RV, or other recreational vehicles. Whether you're an outdoor enthusiast, collector, or simply need exceptional storage and workspace, this versatile building is designed to accommodate your lifestyle. The accessory dwelling provides the perfect space for hosting guests, accommodating multi-generational living, or creating a private home office, adding even more flexibility to this remarkable property. Combining privacy, quality craftsmanship, smart-home convenience, exceptional storage for all your North Idaho adventures, and endless versatility, this remarkable property presents a rare opportunity to enjoy refined country living just moments from the amenities, recreation, and charm of downtown Sandpoint.

Stunning natural beauty meets extravagant living in this exceptional 2,949-square-foot luxury waterfront condominium featuring 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Located in Building 8, the newest addition to Seasons at Sandpoint, this residence showcases distinctive contemporary finishes and exclusive access to the building's rooftop heated pool, 2 heated underground parking spaces, and a secure roll up storage unit. Designed with sophistication and comfort in mind, the home features quartz countertops, soaring 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, custom tile showers, and a premium Thermador appliance package. Heated underground parking and personal storage provide added convenience and security. Seasons at Sandpoint offers an unparalleled resort-style lifestyle with amenities including an in-house spa, Owner's Retreat, private beach, year-round heated outdoor pool, and hot tub. Beyond the property, endless recreation awaits—from strolling the shops and restaurants of downtown Sandpoint to boating on Lake Pend Oreille, skiing at Schweitzer Mountain Resort, and golfing at The Idaho Club, Idaho's only Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course. This is a rare opportunity to own a legacy waterfront residence in one of North Idaho's most sought-after luxury communities.

Set along the tranquil waters of Fry Creek, this exceptional waterfront estate offers a beautifully, custom finished living space with 4 bedrooms (1 nonconforming) and 4 bathrooms. Designed with both comfort and entertaining in mind, the home features soaring ceilings, expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, Thermador appliances, quartz countertops, custom tile work, and an open-concept layout filled with natural light and stunning creek views. The spacious main-level primary suite provides direct access to the large stamped concrete patio and features a luxurious ensuite bath with dual vanities and a custom multi-head tile shower. Upstairs, additional bedrooms are privately situated alongside a comfortable sitting area and sun deck overlooking the water. Complementing the main residence is a well-appointed guest quarters attached to the impressive 35' x 55' hydronic-heated, fully insulated shop. The ADU offers 900 square foot 1 bedroom, 2 bathrooms, a full kitchen, laundry, and additional living space, providing flexibility for guests, multi-generational living, or rental potential. The meticulously landscaped grounds create a true outdoor retreat, complete with expansive stamped concrete patios, two fire pits, an outdoor shower, outdoor soaking bath, and a private boat dock. Enjoy easy access to Sandpoint amenities and a scenic boat ride to the open waters of Lake Pend Oreille from this remarkable waterfront property.

Nestled beneath the majestic Cathedral Rock, surrounded by lush forests and overlooking the serene Pend Oreille River and stunning mountain vistas, this extraordinary 9.09-acre estate showcases the natural beauty that makes North Idaho so special. The 3,598 sq. ft. custom residence offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and an impressive blend of luxury, craftsmanship, and privacy. Step inside to a spacious open-concept design where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow seamlessly together beneath soaring ceilings and expansive windows that frame the breathtaking landscape. The chef's kitchen features a Sub-Zero refrigerator, 5-burner Wolf range, European soft-touch cabinetry, custom backsplash, and a striking waterfall island. The dining area, accented with reclaimed barnwood, opens to a covered patio ideal for outdoor entertaining. Anchored by a stunning Montana stone fireplace, the living room provides a warm and inviting gathering space. Upstairs, panoramic views of the Pend Oreille River and surrounding mountains take center stage. Vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings, a spacious library, and an expansive family room add character and comfort. The primary suite is a private retreat featuring a cozy window seat, balcony access, a large walk-in closet, and a luxurious ensuite bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and custom tile shower. A second ensuite bedroom offers abundant natural light, a walk-in closet, and private deck access, while an additional bedroom on the main level provides flexibility for guests or family. The exterior beautifully combines reclaimed local barnwood and Corten steel, creating a timeless design that complements the natural surroundings. Additional improvements include a whimsical treehouse, a 24' x 40' pole barn with loft storage and electrical service, a teepee with an expansive deck area, and a versatile steel workshop featuring living quarters, a full bath, kitchenette, recording studio, hydronic heat, independent power, and water supplied by an artesian well. Offering exceptional privacy while remaining conveniently close to Sandpoint, this remarkable property provides easy access to boating on Lake Pend Oreille, skiing at Schweitzer, golfing at the Idaho Club, and all the recreation, dining, and shopping North Idaho has to offer. A rare opportunity to own a one-of-a-kind mountain retreat on 9.09 acres in an unforgettable setting.

Experience elevated waterfront living on the pristine shores of Lake Pend Oreille. This tastefully and extensively renovated 2468 sq ft residence with 1152 sq ft detached garage and ADU (on .71 acres) blends refined comfort with the kind of natural beauty that defines North Idaho. Expansive windows frame sweeping lake and mountain views, filling the home with light and creating a seamless connection between indoor living and the outdoors. Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, the home features generous living spaces, a well-appointed kitchen, and inviting gathering areas that open to the waterfront. Step outside to an expansive deck, lush yard, outdoor patio, and private dock—perfect for early morning coffee, afternoon boating, or sunset evenings on the water. Here, lake life isn’t a getaway—it’s your everyday. Adding flexibility and value, the detached accessory dwelling unit offers ideal accommodations for guests, extended family, or potential rental income, all while maintaining privacy from the main residence. Located just 15 minutes from downtown Sandpoint, you’ll enjoy the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience—close to dining, shopping, marinas, and year-round recreation, yet tucked away in your own private waterfront retreat. Whether it’s boating in the summer, cozy fireside winters, or simply soaking in the views, this is more than a home—it’s a lifestyle defined by the water.
